findings.title: Missing detailed scope for site establishment
findings.message: The short text only states "Baustelleneinrichtung" without specifying the required facilities, equipment, or services, which violates VOB/A § 7 Abs. 1 (eindeutig, erschöpfend).
findings.suggestion: Add a detailed description of all site facilities (e.g., temporary offices, storage, sanitation, security) and quantities.

findings.title: Lack of technical specifications for earthworks
findings.message: No soil class, excavation depth, or profile requirements are given, contrary to STLB‑Bau standard texts (e.g., DIN 18300, DIN 18331).
findings.suggestion: Specify soil type, required excavation depth, profile tolerances and any necessary soil handling measures.

findings.title: Missing disposal method and waste classification
findings.message: The position only says "Bodenmaterial entsorgen" without indicating waste class, disposal route or required permits, which is required by VOB/C § 4.2 and environmental regulations.
findings.suggestion: Add waste classification (e.g., B2), disposal site, transport requirements and any recycling obligations.

findings.title: Unspecified frost protection material
findings.message: The text does not state the type, grade or installation method of the frost protection layer, which is required for a complete STLB‑Bau specification.
findings.suggestion: Specify material (e.g., granular fill, geotextile), minimum thickness and compaction criteria.

findings.title: Missing technical data for gate valve DN 150
findings.message: No material, pressure rating, actuation type or installation details are provided, violating VOB/A § 7 Abs. 1 and typical ATV specifications.
findings.suggestion: Add material (e.g., ductile iron), PN rating, type of operation (manual/automatic) and mounting details.

findings.title: Insufficient specifications for shaft DN 1000
findings.message: The position lacks concrete class, reinforcement details, waterproofing and access provisions, which are mandatory in STLB‑Bau.
findings.suggestion: Specify concrete strength (e.g., C30/37), reinforcement layout, lining, and any required waterproofing.

findings.title: Missing brick and mortar specifications for masonry
findings.message: Only "Mauerwerk KS 17,5 cm" is given; the brick type, mortar class, bond pattern and reinforcement are absent, contrary to VOB/C requirements.
findings.suggestion: State brick classification (e.g., K2), mortar class (e.g., M5), bond type and any reinforcement.

findings.title: Undefined interior plaster type and thickness
findings.message: The position does not indicate plaster material (e.g., gypsum, cement), thickness, or surface finish, which is required for a complete specification.
findings.suggestion: Add plaster type, minimum thickness (e.g., 12 mm), and finish class.

findings.title: Empty description
findings.message: Both short and long texts are missing, making the position undefined and non‑enforceable under VOB/A § 7 Abs. 1.
findings.suggestion: Provide a clear description of the intended work, including material, dimensions and performance criteria.

findings.title: Missing insulation material and performance data
findings.message: Only "Wärmedämmung Boden" is stated; the insulation type, thickness and thermal conductivity (WLS) are not specified.
findings.suggestion: Specify insulation material (e.g., XPS), thickness (e.g., 100 mm) and WLS value (e.g., 0.035 W/(m·K)).

findings.title: Lack of waterproofing material and class
findings.message: The position does not name the waterproofing system, its class or application method, which is required by DIN 18533.
findings.suggestion: State waterproofing membrane type, thickness, and water ingress class (e.g., W1.2‑E).

findings.title: Undefined paving slab specifications
findings.message: No information on slab type, thickness, joint width or reinforcement is provided, which is needed for a complete specification.
findings.suggestion: Add slab material (e.g., concrete class C30/37), thickness (e.g., 120 mm), joint details and reinforcement.

findings.title: Missing asphalt mix class and thickness
findings.message: Only "Asphaltdeckschicht einbauen" is given; the asphalt mix type, nominal thickness and compaction criteria are absent.
findings.suggestion: Specify mix class (e.g., AC 16), minimum thickness (e.g., 50 mm) and required density.

findings.title: Duplicate site establishment without differentiated scope
findings.message: Identical to OZ 2.1.1.10 but no distinction of phase‑specific requirements; risk of double billing and unclear responsibility.
findings.suggestion: Clarify whether this is a separate phase and list any additional or changed facilities.

findings.title: Missing technical data for second earthwork batch
findings.message: Same lack of soil class, depth and profile as OZ 2.1.1.40, violating STLB‑Bau completeness.
findings.suggestion: Provide the same detailed specifications as for the first batch, adjusted for any phase differences.

findings.title: Missing disposal details for second batch
findings.message: Same deficiency as OZ 2.1.1.50 – no waste class, disposal route or recycling requirements.
findings.suggestion: Add waste classification, disposal site and any recycling obligations.

findings.title: Missing specifications for second frost protection layer
findings.message: Same omission as OZ 2.1.1.60 – material type, thickness and compaction not defined.
findings.suggestion: Specify material, minimum thickness and installation criteria for the second phase.
